items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 02 September 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland as various fronts affect Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 occasionally 6 tonight, then decreasing Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow morning. Then increasing Southwest 5 or 6 for a time later tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain developing tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, veering West 5 or 6 overnight into Friday, occasionally 7 in places on Friday mornin.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate, moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather##

Rain clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
